body.text: Original Report
Yuejin: first time, it hit a few seconds after I swallowed the dextro. Feeling it the moment it goes down is genuinely scary.
### Twenty-five
2024.04.03.19:53 Yuejin: dextro.
2024.04.03.21:17 Yuejin: adding Goodnight.
### Twenty-six
2024.04.04.06:11 Yuejin: can't stand it, o-ing some Goodnight.
2024.04.04.06:46 Yuejin: still nothing, added dextro again.
2024.04.04.08:04 Yuejin: still nothing, feels awful, added Goodnight again. The effects are terrifying.
### Twenty-seven
2024.04.06.21:22 Yuejin: dextro plus Goodnight. Scared, but I just want one big one.
2024.04.07.02:56 Yuejin: insomnia. I'm using quetiapine to force a shutdown.
2024.04.07.03:24 Yuejin: why won't it shut down.
### Twenty-nine
2024.04.10.22:22 Yuejin: dextro.
2024.04.10.23:24 Yuejin: threw up.
2024.04.10.03:04 Yuejin: adding dextro.
2024.04.10.03:37 Yuejin: adding Goodnight.
2024.04.10.07:40 Yuejin: woke up, but... where's my high?!
### Thirty-two
2024.04.22.22:09 Yuejin: I'll o this much for now; if I dissociate I'll o more dextro, because with the first dose I'm afraid I'll die.
2024.04.22.22:59 Yuejin: threw up a lot of stomach fluid, but added more.

2024.04.22.23:41 Yuejin: delirium, like a stretch of memory was pulled out of me. Lay in bed, threw up all over it, forgot. I do remember going to the mirage. This one actually felt like an od, except the brain fog lingers.
### Thirty-four
2024.04.27.17:00 Yuejin: drank a bottle of double-grapefruit juice, started on the dextro at 17:08.
2024.04.27.17:27 Yuejin: damn, got a bit of a headache. Finished them, nauseating; it took me 20 minutes to swallow.
2024.04.27.17:31 Yuejin: ??? feels like obvious dissociation???? why so fast?

2024.04.27.18:33 Yuejin: such strong dissociation! My brain and I are two completely different people! As soon as I sit up my brain keeps running on its own, I can't control it, my vision blurs, I feel like I'm going to die.
2024.04.27.18:39 Yuejin: feels like the word 'death' is flashing all over my body; hands shaking, want to throw up more.
2024.04.27.18:56 Yuejin: keep sleeping. Extremely sensitive to music.
2024.04.27.20:14 Yuejin: in the toilet, ugh, a smell of medicine.
Handler's Note
The report breaks off here. No resolution, no 'afterwards'. The last update in the original stops at 'in the toilet, ugh, a smell of medicine'.
